Get started as a designer


1. Install TeleNeo and TeleNeo Var

The following font is part of the Telekom brand and design assets. It is not open source and may not be used freely. The express consent of Deutsche Telekom is required for commercial use.

https://www.brand-design.telekom.com/asset/font-0-teleneo/


2. Access to ODS Figma Libraries

For Telekom Employees:

Step 1: Get a Telekom Enterprise account by following these instructions.

Step 2: Migrate your working files from an external account into our Telekom Figma account in order to utilize the library and reconnect the components. Reach out to the Telekom Figma Admin for assistance, or submit a ticket to Figma Support.

Step 3: Invite external collaborators to the files using the share feature in Figma. External collaborators will require edit rights in the Telekom Figma Account to collaborate, and any associated costs will be charged to the project cost center.

For Externals:

Externals can utilize the ODS libraries exclusively with a Telekom Figma Enterprise Account.

Step 1: Migrate your working files to your Telekom Figma account to utilize the library and reconnect the components. If you need assistance, contact your Telekom Figma Admin or submit a ticket to Figma Support.

Step 2: Obtain a guest account with the Telekom Figma Enterprise Account. Typically, after migrating your project, all collaborators in the files are automatically added as guests to Telekom. If you do not yet have access to Telekom Figma, please contact your Telekom internal project contacts to get an invitation. Be sure to mention the project you are working on and provide the name of an internal contact person you are collaborating with.


3. Check out the guidelines

Make yourself familiar with the documentation of the design system. The ODS Guidelines contain all relevant informations regarding building components, foundations and usage of the components. Please also take a look at the One Experience Identity Guideline. It contains many valuable tips and examples on how to design your products in line with the One Experience.


4. Activate the ODS libraries in Figma

Depending on the theme, these are the files you need to activate:

One ID Theme/Web:

Select the ODS One ID Web Components, the Systems Foundation for One ID and the Icon Library.

One ID Theme/Mobile:

Select the ODS One ID Components Mobile, the Systems Foundation for One ID and the Icon Library.


Base Theme/Web:

Select the ODS Base Web Components, the Systems Foundation for Base and the Icon Library.

One ID Theme/Mobile:

Select the ODS Base Mobile Components, the Systems Foundation for Base and the Icon Library.

Please also see How to implement the ODS in an existing product. This might help to choose a theme.


Legal notes

Deutsche Telekom reserves all rights to the Telekom brand. The Telekom theme must be completely replaced for any usage that is not explicitly intended for the Telekom.
